question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The comedian's jokes were so funny that the audience was __laughing uncontrollably__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"in stitches"** means laughing uncontrollably or hysterically. (हँसी से लोटपोट होना)

 
 
• **Example: **The movie was so hilarious that we were all in stitches by the end of it.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **On the ball **(चौकस और कुशल): Being alert and efficient.

 
 
• **Example:** The new employee is always on the ball, completing tasks ahead of schedule.
 
 
 
• **As easy as pie **(बहुत आसान): Very easy to do.
 
 
• **Example: **Solving this puzzle was as easy as pie for him.
 
 
 
• **In bits and pieces** (टुकड़ों में): In small, separate stages.
 
 
• **Example:** The old book was falling apart in bits and pieces.
